note: Lead lines on climbs, vaults, roof jumps and drops (route beats in chase/evade objectives; docs/briefs/MOVEMENT.md). context = lead.

lines.text: I was a cop. Cops take the stairs. Inside stairs.
Thirty-four years old and I'm climbing a fire escape. Ma would love this.
Who builds a roof this far from the next roof?
Knees. I used to have knees.
Over the hood. Sorry, pal. Send me the bill.
Rule four: never run where you can climb.
Heels off. Heels in the bag. Go.
Up, over, down. Count it. Up, over, down.
Thirty-five cents for the train. Not tonight.
Gap's nothing. The landing's the thing.
He's heavy. He won't make the jump. I will.
I am a businessman! Businessmen use doors!
This suit was two hundred dollars. Was.
In Kastoria we climbed mountains. I was nine. I'm not nine.
My heart. My heart, my heart. Keep going.
Fence. Of course there's a fence.
